risk_if_not_implemented: Without Respond To Unauthorized Changes, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Incident Persistence / Recurrence (R-IR-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Software & Firmware Patching
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct software patching for all deployed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including firmware.
compensating_control_1.justification: Software & Firmware Patching (VPM-08) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Respond To Unauthorized Changes (CFG-08.1) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE)
compensating_control_2.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to:
(1) Identify unauthorized deviations from an approved secure baseline configuration; and
(2) Implement automated resiliency actions to remediate the unauthorized change.
compensating_control_2.justification: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE) (CFG-08.2) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Respond To Unauthorized Changes (CFG-08.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
